text:
alex_sales: Quick sync — Acme Health needs an order form signed by COB Friday. They prefer a bank wire to close, but their procurement team is pushing DocuSign. Can legal confirm acceptable fallback flow?

maria_legal: We can accept bank wire, but only after a countersigned contract. Prefer digital signature (DocuSign/Adobe). If procurement insists on wire-first, we need: PO with tax ID, written authorization from the buyer, and an exec approval for >$250k. Also need to tighten DPA language around subprocessors.

ken_pm: Heads up — customer asked about reserved capacity pricing for the POC. Sales proposed a 1-month reserved pool at a discount vs pay-as-you-go. Finance needs a clear billing trigger (start date = first production token processed?) to avoid disputes.

sam_engineer: For the POC we require Dedicated pool + KMS attestation. We can provide a signed attestation doc for KMS keys hosted in our cloud. HSM-backed keys (customer-managed HSM) are possible but add 2-3w lead time.

maria_legal: I'll draft a short redline to the Master Agreement and Data Processing Addendum: allow electronic signatures via DocuSign or Adobe Sign; bank wire only allowed as a payment method after countersign and receipt of PO. For KMS wording I'll change to "reasonable evidence of key control" rather than absolute warranty.

alex_sales: Can we agree SLA credit structure? Acme is asking for 30% credit for downtime >1 hour. Our standard is a monthly credit cap of 25% and single-incident cap 10%.

maria_legal: Proposed language: "Customer may receive service credits up to 25% of the monthly charges in a billing period. For any single incident, credits are capped at 10% of the monthly charges." Also need to specify that uptime measurement is based on Redwood telemetry and link the SLA calculation method.

alex_sales: Perfect. Finance also needs the PO payload for wire processing. sample PO payload:```
{
  "po_number": "PO-ACME-2024-0912",
  "amount": "120000.00",
  "currency": "USD",
  "tax_id": "12-3456789",
  "bill_to": "Redwood Inference LLC",
  "notes": "Payment conditioned on countersigned Master Agreement and DPA"
}
```

deploy-bot: Template uploaded — orderform_v3 and MSA_redline_v2 are in the drive: https://redwood.co/drive/orderform_v3 (permissions: sales+legal)

ken_pm: Security questionnaire timeline: procurement wants completed SecQ by EOW. Sam, can you handle KMS/HSM and runtime isolation answers? We should push docu-sign to avoid postal delays.

sam_engineer: I'll take KMS/HSM + infra isolation. Will attach KMS attestation and a brief note on dedicated pool isolation by EOD. If they insist on manual signature it may add 48-72h.

maria_legal: If they require wet-ink we need a paper-signing clause (mailing address, signatory name, and original document retention clause). My recommendation: accept digital signatures and reserve paper only as a last resort.

alex_sales: I'll escalate with their procurement and suggest DocuSign to keep timeline. tagging @maria_legal and @sam_engineer for final docs and attestation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
